Register / Update Certification Information

API for registering and updating certification information.

get https://apiweb.shoplinker.co.kr/ShoplinkerApi/Product/cert_info_reg.php?iteminfo_url=XML URL[URL-encoded]

Request Parameters

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. Required customer_id string Customer code (Shoplinker registration code) Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. linkage_update_yn string Update linked product DB Allowed values
  1. - Update linked product db : Y
  2. - Do not update linked product db : N
Default : N
3. Required partner_product_id string Your own product code
certinfo Up to 5 entries can be registered.
4. cert_item string Certification code When entering certification information Required item.
You can query this in Additional Administrator Functions -> Basic Information Query.
5. cert_organ string Certification authority name
6. cert_no string Certification number When entering certification information Required item.
7. cert_notify_no string Certification declaration number
8. cert_issuedate string Certification issue date yyyymmdd
9. cert_valid_from string Certification validity start date yyyymmdd
10. cert_valid_until string Certification validity end date yyyymmdd
11. cert_image_url string Certification image URL http://image.shoplinker.co.kr/images/banner/bn_admin_150210_3.jpg A web-accessible path

XML sample

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr"?>
<Shoplinker>
	<product>
		<customer_id>a0000001</customer_id>
		<partner_product_id>p_56438</partner_product_id>
		<linkage_update_yn>Y</linkage_update_yn>
		<certinfo>
			<cert>
				<cert_item>C001</cert_item>
				<cert_organ><![CDATA[http://image.shoplinker.co.kr/images/banner/bn_admin_150210_3.jpg]]></cert_organ>
				<cert_no><![CDATA[KN-05891]]></cert_no>
				<cert_issuedate><![CDATA[20160909]]></cert_issuedate>
				<cert_valid_from><![CDATA[20160909]]></cert_valid_from>
				<cert_valid_until><![CDATA[20160909]]></cert_valid_until>
				<cert_image_url><![CDATA[http://image.shoplinker.co.kr/images/banner/bn_admin_150210_3.jpg]]></cert_image_url>
			</cert>
			<cert>
				<cert_item>C001</cert_item>
				<cert_no><![CDATA[KN-05891]]></cert_no>
			</cert>
			.
			.
			.
			<cert>
				반복
			</cert>
		</certinfo>
	</product>
</Shoplinker>

Response

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. result bool Result flag Allowed values
  1. - Success : true
  2. - Failure : false
 Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. product_id string Shoplinker product code Shoplinker product code
ex) prod0001213
3. message string Result message Success or failure message 
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr"?>
<Shoplinker>
	<ResultMessage>
		<result>true</result>
		<product_id>P1524578</product_id>
		<message>등록성공</message>
	</ResultMessage>
</Shoplinker>
